title: 1Password breach exposed your email and name, but your vault is safe
summary: A full root cause analysis is due in the coming weeks
content: 1Password says an attacker copied customer account records from its backend systems, including the names and email addresses people use to sign in. The company says vault contents and the keys that protect them were not affected, which leaves phishing as the main risk.

title: Every way to watch local news on your TV for free in 2026
summary: From over the air setups to NewsON and Local Now growth, find practical coverage that matches your market.
content: Earlier this year, I wrote about how I like to watch local news even though I cut the cord years ago . I also mentioned the best ways to do so for free. A few months later, that list already needs an update. Since then, one of the apps on my list has a new owner, while another has added over 100 new local stations. At the same time, the big networks keep pushing their own local news streams on free services.

title: OpenAI admits a billing error, and your GPT-6.2 usage now burns faster
summary: OpenAI blames a launch mistake and offers one saved reset
content: OpenAI says it made a billing mistake when GPT-6.2 launched, undercounting how much usage Astra and Sol consumed. Now that the issue has been fixed, the same tasks use more of your plan's allowance, and OpenAI is adding one banked reset as an apology.
